📺 Kickin’ It (2011–2015)

Kickin’ It follows Jack Brewer, a talented young martial artist who joins the struggling Bobby Wasabi Martial Arts Academy at a shopping mall in California. After discovering that the dojo is filled with a group of lovable misfits, Jack uses his incredible karate skills and determination to help his new friends become better fighters and more confident individuals. Alongside the hilarious and unpredictable Rudy Gillespie, the dojo’s eccentric sensei, Jack develops close friendships with Kim Crawford, Jerry Martinez, Milton Krupnick, and Eddie Jones. Together, they experience outrageous adventures, school rivalries, hilarious misunderstandings, exciting martial arts competitions, and unexpected challenges that constantly test their teamwork. From defending their dojo against rivals to navigating teenage relationships and everyday problems, the group proves that friendship, loyalty, and believing in yourself are just as important as mastering karate. Starring Leo Howard, Dylan Riley Snyder, Mateo Arias, Olivia Holt, Alex Christian Jones, and Jason Earles, the series combines action-packed comedy, unforgettable characters, and heartwarming lessons about courage, friendship, and never giving up.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Action • Martial Arts • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-Y7

🎥 Creator: Jim O’Doherty

📺 Seasons: 4 • 84 Episodes

📚 Setting: Bobby Wasabi Martial Arts Academy in Seaford, California.

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ (United States)

source_details.synopsis: Kickin' It is an American comedy television series created by Jim O'Doherty that aired on Disney XD from June 13, 2011 to March 25, 2015. The series stars Leo Howard, Dylan Riley Snyder, Mateo Arias, Olivia Holt, Alex Christian Jones, and Jason Earles.
